Issue #482: Long messages overflow the widget container
Opened by: tara-singh
Date: October 17, 2026
Labels: bug, ui

Description:
In production, long unbroken strings in a patient message overflow the bubble instead of wrapping. I only see it with real transcripts, so I'm attaching the screenshot from the live widget.

Steps to reproduce:
1. Open the conversation for Noah Kim (202-555-0148) in the support console.
2. Scroll to the message that begins "Since they changed my diabetes medication I've had nausea and dizziness, can someone at the hospital call me back..."
3. Resize the window below 400px wide.

Expected: text wraps at the container edge.
Actual: text runs past the edge and the phone number is clipped.

Screenshot: widget-overflow.png (top of widget shows name, phone, and symptom text)

I'll close this once the CSS fix ships.
